integration_removed.description:
The Fitbit integration has been removed from Home Assistant.

On November 2, 2026, Google permanently shut down the legacy Fitbit Web API ([Fitbit Web API Migration Guide]({migration_guide})). Because legacy Fitbit OAuth credentials and tokens do not carry over, existing entries can no longer sync data or re-authenticate.

To resolve this issue:
1. Set up the [Google Health integration]({google_health_docs}), which replaces the Fitbit integration using the Google Health API.
2. Remove your defunct [Fitbit integration entries]({entries}).
3. Optionally remove any unused Fitbit OAuth credentials in [Application credentials]({application_credentials}).

Once all Fitbit entries are removed, this issue will automatically clear.
integration_removed.title: The Fitbit integration has been removed
